decision: Authorize exactly one bounded governance delivery (ANOX-TASK-B028-SCALABLE-GOVERNANCE-FOUNDATION-001 on branch governance/b028-foundation-001, from canonical main 32c729ceb6991447698c7ec8deee7278e36d333d) that establishes the B-028 Scalable Governance architecture as an additive authority track and delivers its generic foundation tooling in non-enforcing advisory mode: B-028 design doc + registry/authority-index entries; session schema + domain_tiers.json + test_map.jsonl + ci_verdicts.jsonl; seal_event.py (hash-chained sealing), render_surfaces.py (deterministic rendering + drift check), validate_session_evidence.py (generic session ingest), ingest_ci_verdict.py (canonical CI verdict binding), risk_classifier.py (deterministic audit depth), next_step.py (authorized-bundle resolver), validate_prompt.py (prompt scope enforcement); canonical coordinator rules under docs/workforce/coordination/; adversarial test suites; and the follow-on candidate ANOX-TASK-B028-DUAL-RUN-CUTOVER-001 (start_sha NOT YET BOUND).

B-028 verifies transitions by construction — hash-chained ledger events, manifest-driven session ingest, deterministic audit depth, CI-bound retest evidence, single-source surface rendering, and a prompt registry binding the external coordinator into the governed artifact chain. Delivering the machinery as additive/advisory preserves every existing acceptance authority until a separate human-ratified cutover decision.
